ownership: PA40 lint policy and actual diagnostics
source_generation: Start with #![expect(hidden_glob_reexports)] followed by newline and mod base{.
Append pub mod leaf{index}{} for index in range(fanout_width), then } and newline.
Append pub mod fanout{index}{pub use super::base::*;mod leaf0{}} and newline for index in range(fanout_width).
Append #[doc="retained"]pub fn owner{index}(){} and newline for index in range(attributed_functions).
requirements: Use completed expanded name resolution or --emit-types; plain --emit-names alone does not exercise this producer.

Both uncapped and Allow compilations complete the actual source with no warnings. The uncapped root expectation is fulfilled from real namespace causes; Allow keeps its witnessed expectation deferred, never fulfilled.
Import work/attempted allocations remain cumulative under their existing finite payer. Earlier resolver history is not added to a separate smaller lint budget.

The existing lint producer prepays new Cause vector growth, copied slots, source witnesses and publication before allocation or mutation. Failed attempts remain sticky and publish no partial cause vector.
Keep exact source/import/counterpart identity, deterministic event ordering, allow/deny/forbid/expect, empty/forged/exhausted opponents and ordinary record widths.
The retained declaration/binding graph has fanout_width squared contributions: scaling is measured against actual output, not assumed linear in fanout_width.
